svg.title: Three guardrails sit at three distinct failure boundaries, and none substitutes for the other two.
svg.desc: A pre-execution security gate validates permission against wiki rules. An in-loop step validator checks each proposed action and reworks it if flawed. A post-execution three-mode guard checks the response against API evidence and policy. The focused summary states that each check guards a different failure.

text.font-family: Space Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Guardrails cover three distinct failure boundaries

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Each check sits next to the failure it can prevent.
